svg.title: Ammar Munir
svg.desc: Lead engineer at Arq Tech. An animated funnel answers what does ammar build. Eight sources flow into a context window that fills to 170 thousand tokens: GitHub, Slack and AWS MCP servers, a policy library, a CVE feed, questionnaires, UI/UX snapshots of web, extension and mobile, and Mem0 memory. The context is distilled from 2,400 chunks to 40 with reciprocal rank fusion and 12 with a cross-encoder, UI/UX and contradiction checks pass, and the answer cites its sources.
svg.text: I build agentic RAG and LLM systems that answer with their sources.

text.tspan: Agents that take in a lot of messy context, distill it, check
their own work and cite every source
